title: The bathrooms.
content: Hello. I’m not sure what we are all doing here or why. I can’t say I’m happy to meet everyone. This popped up somehow and to be honest had me nauseous as i read post after post and comments. The bathrooms. I will share more as i can it’s quite alarming to stumble upon this. I mean, there isn’t anything remotely enjoyable about this sub. Sorry to say but this is like horrifying. Please share any reassurance or positivity… I suppose it’s nice to meet all of you. I just didn’t know you folks existed nor did i know my reoccurring dream was common down to the architecture, that I’ve never seen in real life. I’ve also never had any bad public bathroom experiences to my knowledge. Quite honestly this is giving me a headache and is unsettling. Anyone have theories regarding WHY/WHAT? I’m harping on the bathrooms but sadly I’m 10/10 for the whole mall layouts and most of your experiences 😭😭😭😭.
